announcement.quote: As we move closer to the stockholder vote on the proposed reorganization of the First Opportunity Fund, Inc. (the “Fund”), Boulder Total Return Fund, Inc., The Denali Fund Inc., and Boulder Growth & Income Fund, Inc. into a single surviving fund

deals.notes: FOFI is shown as OTC-quoted (the Sept 2014 release says the surviving fund is to be listed on the NYSE), so the pair is not shown as both exchange-listed. For information only: FOFI's own N-8F (0001104659-15-038210, filed 2015-05-14) states it merged into Boulder Growth & Income Fund, Inc. with closing on March 20, 2015 (Merger, shareholder vote November 14, 2014), which would be 'completed' if the pair counted as listed. Not a failure.
